name: Gold Standard Integration LLC
address: 2161 US-1 Ste b, Jupiter, FL 33477, USA

reviews.name: Daniel G.
reviews.text: This company in one word is AMAZING. They show up when scheduled on time EVERYTIME! They are very thorough ,going through any issue you have. Brent, the owner I would say is a wizard of an electrical contractor. His knowledge surpasses his years. In my 38 years of doing this, I’ve never worked with a company as organized and knowledgeable as them. Continuous follow ups to make sure our schedules are met and the work being complete is what we expect. I’ve worked in multiple states throughout my career on both coast and I give Brent and his team my highest recommendation. Call them you will agree

reviews.name: Lyn C.
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Gold Standard Electrical, I was “in the dark” and they solved my issue quickly and efficiently. Not only is this company prompt, kind, and courteous they made sure to clean up before during and after their work. I’m so glad I was recommended to Gold Standard, and I will use them for all my electrical issues in the future. I never even mentioned that the price was so fair!! All around 5 star service.

reviews.name: Justin
reviews.text:
Brent and his team did an amazing job running a 100 amp panel from my house to my pole barn. Brent was really helpful in making suggestions on how to set it up so there was less work needed in the future when lighting and other electrical work would need to be done.

Highly recommended these guys!

reviews.name: Morgan S.
reviews.text: The best!! We had a few projects in our new house that needed attention and Brent made it happen. Super timely, responsive, and professional. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Lisa
reviews.text: Brent and Hunter were kind and paid close attention to detail. They were a pleasure to have in our home. I know we will be using them again in the future!
